project_type: Express.js backend with MongoDB/Mongoose, deployed on Vercel separately from Next.js frontend
build_system: npm with nodemon for development, no compilation step
test_framework: Jest with supertest for API tests
build_command: npm run dev (development) or npm start (production)
test_command: npm test (runs Jest tests in backend directory)
verification_instructions:
1. Run npm test in backend directory to execute Jest tests
2. For manual testing, use curl or Postman to test API endpoints
3. Check for any console errors during server startup
4. Verify database connections work
environment_constraints: Production deployment uses separate Vercel domains: frontend (ai-interview-system-dqc9.vercel.app) and backend (ai-interview-system-eewl.vercel.app). Cookies must use sameSite: 'none' and secure: true in production.
contribution_requirements: Files must maintain ES module syntax (import/export). Follow existing code patterns. Use async/await for database operations. Include proper error handling.
key_patterns:
1. Controllers use try/catch blocks with consistent error responses
2. Services return formatted data or throw errors
3. Middleware attaches data to req object (e.g., req.candidate)
4. Cookies set with environment-aware configuration
5. Status codes follow REST conventions
directory_structure:
backend/src/
  modules/
    candidate/ - Candidate models and services
    student/ - Student authentication and portal APIs
    verification/ - OTP verification system
  middleware/ - Authentication middleware
  app.js - Main Express app with CORS configuration
frontend/
  app/student/ - Student portal pages
  components/student/ - Student UI components
